title: A Child's Question in Santa Fe and Polaroid's One-Minute Picture
conflicts: Date of the Santa Fe question: 1943 (Linda Hall, Lemelson-MIT, Physics Today, History.com) vs 1944 (Royal Society memoir by F. W. Campbell, citing Land); story gives both. First camera: Model 95 (HBS, Campbell, Lemelson) vs 'Model 95A' (History.com); Model 95 used. Price $89.75 (Campbell, History.com) vs $89.95/$87.50 on secondary pages; $89.75 used. Sold-out claim given as 'reportedly'.
notes: The daughter's question is told as Land's own account, quoted from the Royal Society memoir (Internet Archive copy of the Rowland Institute reprint, because rowland.harvard.edu blocks automated requests); no dialogue invented. Adds the post-war collapse in Polaroid's sales from the HBS Baker Library timeline (company records). Quote stance: affirms.
